definitions.gloss: light eater; small appetite; eating sparingly
definitions.explanation: The tendency to eat only small amounts of food. Describes someone who naturally doesn't eat much.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{小食|しょうしょく}だ。
{小食|しょうしょく}なので、{大盛|おおも}りは{食|た}べきれない。
examples.english: I'm a light eater, so I can't finish a large portion.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は{小食|しょうしょく}だったが、{大人|おとな}になってよく{食|た}べるようになった。
examples.english: I was a light eater as a child, but I started eating more as an adult.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective or noun. Describes a natural disposition rather than deliberate dieting. The opposite is {大食|たいしょく} (big eater) or {大食|おおぐ}い (glutton, casual).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大食|たいしょく}: big eater — the opposite, eating large amounts
- {少食|しょうしょく}: same word with alternate kanji — both are used
